effective_native_cell_rule: Arithmetic mean of absolute embedded affine x/y pixel sizes because the two axes agree to numerical precision; embedded geometry overrides rounded portal label for cell-based method scaling.

heldout_domain_bridge.rule: Densify the frozen backscatter header rectangle edges in EPSG:4326, transform those geometry points to EPSG:32629, construct the transformed polygon, then inward-buffer it by the maximum derived radius. This uses header geometry only and no backscatter values.
